experiment.claim: Issue #19 -- NOT a spec claim (spec/target-spec.md does not exist yet, spec/porting-plan.md Sec4 item 4). Substantiates that bias_core reaches its intended operating branch (VREF ~1.25 V, ~1 uA quiescent draw, BIAS_OK asserted) from a physical 0 V cold start at every point of the full 45-point PVT matrix -- i.e. that the on-die startup kick reliably breaks the degenerate zero-current state without any solver assistance. This is the branch-selection counterpart to sim/bias-core-smoke/, whose cold `.op` cannot make that claim: a `.op` has no initial state, so which branch it lands on is chosen by ngspice's gmin-stepping continuation rather than by the circuit. See sim/bias-core-op-branch/ for the measured evidence that the two spurious `.op` points in sim/bias-core-smoke/records/20260825-214036-a9cac4b.md are solver artifacts, not a second stable state.
